text: そろそろ　うきわ　なしで　およぎたいの

patterns.name: 〜なしで
patterns.explanation: なしで after a thing means doing something without it. うきわ　なしで = 'without a swim ring'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do'. およぎたい = 'want to swim'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is the soft girlish form of のだ, which adds feeling as if explaining yourself. およぎたいの = 'I want to swim, you see'.
